verdict.rationale: The evidence confirms that Motion has a live, documented REST API, and the probe shows a /v1 path prefix. Nothing in the pack documents a versioning scheme or a deprecation policy, which is the core of this story. A version segment in a URL alone does not show that a buyer can rely on versioned APIs with documented deprecation, so the verdict is none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
